name: Extension probe defenses
plain: Browsers blunt the trick of probing for installed extensions by their fixed addresses.
meaning: A page can test chrome-extension://id/file for extensions that expose resources. Chromium MV3 use_dynamic_url and Firefox's per install random address make that probe unreliable, and Safari does not expose stable ids.

web.api: web_accessible_resources with use_dynamic_url (Chromium MV3); moz-extension://UUID; safari-web-extension://

access.prompt_ui: None, set by the extension author

chrome.note: use_dynamic_url opt in per resource entry (Chrome 130); web_accessible_resources itself is older

edge.note: use_dynamic_url opt in per resource entry, same as Chrome

safari.note: web_accessible_resources since 14; the extension base URL is always dynamic in Safari

firefox.note: Random UUID per install blocks cross site probing, but a leaked UUID works within a session

ios_safari.note: Same as Safari: base URL always dynamic

data.metric: Browsers blunt the trick of probing for installed extensions by their fixed addresses.

limits.headline: Can hide an extension from the address probe, if the extension opts in
limits.user_action: None, the page reads it silently
can: Make the extension address change per session in Chromium MV3
Give each Firefox install its own random address
cannot: Stop DOM and global injection traces
Protect extensions that do not opt in
limits.differs: Chromium needs the extension author to opt in. Firefox always randomizes.

story.what_it_is: Defenses that stop a page from learning your extensions by guessing their addresses.

marketing.name: web_accessible_resources
marketing.pitch: Explains how Firefox randomizes extension addresses per install.

story.for_you: Your extensions are harder to list from a web page when they use these defenses.
story.for_makers: Extension authors enable use_dynamic_url to protect their users.

use_cases.example: A password manager enables dynamic URLs so websites cannot detect it.

technical_bounds: Safari packaging details are low confidence
